description: QHora-301W layout v2 (docs/design.md, draft 6). 1 MiB aligned, standard 128-entry GPT. 0:HLOS and 0:HLOS_1 hold two copies of the U-Boot loader: the stock U-Boot falls back to entry 1 by itself when entry 0 fails to load (docs/findings/0004). Both carry the stock 0:HLOS type GUID, since they hold the same kind of content (the stock GPT gives every partition its own type, which the stock U-Boot ignores: it looks them up by name). ubootenv and ubootenv2 hold the primary and redundant U-Boot environment, found by type GUID. rootfs is a 1 MiB placeholder the stock U-Boot needs: its bootipq looks up a GPT partition named rootfs (for root=PARTUUID=) before it loads 0:HLOS, and stops at its prompt if there is none (docs/findings/0006); only its name and GUID are read, never its content. Don't remove it while the stock U-Boot is the APPSBL. Each slot holds its FIT plus that slot's overlay (fitblk maps the space after the FIT as /dev/fitrw, which fstools uses as rootfs_data); 'data' is shared general storage, not an overlay. Partition GUIDs are generated per unit at install time.
